title: Townsend Brown's electrogravitics experiments in the late 1920s
summary: Steven Greer tells of Townsend Brown's electrogravitics experiments in the late 1920s, about 1928-1929 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Okay. So late 1920s they were using very high voltage material uh resonant frequencies certain frequencies at very high voltage but low power.

plain: Steven Greer, a UFO activist, says on Jesse Michels' podcast that in the late 1920s the inventor Townsend Brown was already experimenting with electrogravitics, the idea that strong electric charges can produce a force that works against gravity. Greer says the work used very high voltage at low power, tuned to certain resonant frequencies, and he cites his own Disclosure Project collection of intelligence material. If true, it would mean the roots of anti-gravity research go back almost a century.
